comment: The split is at MIDI_Input.cpp:95-104: channel messages go to CHN and ALL, system common and system realtime go to SYS and ALL. The device gate is isAssigned at :93, so with no device chosen nothing is read at all. Menu item names come from MidiHelper::populateDriverMenu at utils/MidiHelper.cpp:206 and populateInputMenu at :226, with the module passing "MIDI Input Device" as the driver-menu suffix and combined mode off, so the second heading reads MIDI Inputs rather than MIDI Devices. System exclusive is not handled.
